source.note: Review began against uncommitted edits. Another actor committed the reviewed source during inspection. This report pins 7cc2efe and does not review later modifications.

boundaries.qualification: New refusal behavior and its handling change operational failures and call-ledger interpretation. Unchanged inference logic is not evidence of identical historical model outputs.

routes: global configured key and BYOK share buildChatModel
positiveCoverage: Official deepseek.com and *.deepseek.com are guarded from actual request URI even when configured model is not named DeepSeek.
Remote proxy with default configured model starting deepseek receives forceOffPeak=true.
Time is checked in createRequest and immediately before delegate.execute, covering queued requests crossing peak boundaries on recognized endpoints.
SDK maxAttempts stays 1; no production streaming path found, all current calls use model.call.
EvalRunner refuses matching real evaluation before item loop. Dry-run skips admission and does not invoke provider.
callPathReview.negativeCoverage: A remote proxy with non-DeepSeek default model and a DeepSeek modelOverride or escalation remains unguarded. Factory classification is computed from default configuration and never receives the effective request model.
callPathReview.localFixtures: localhost, 127.0.0.1 and IPv6 loopback are exempt from proxy model classification. This exemption is appropriate only for known fake providers; it cannot prove a local forwarding proxy does not reach a real service.
callPathReview.timePolicy: Asia/Shanghai weekday [09:00,12:00) and [14:00,18:00) peak windows; weekday holidays are conservatively refused. Reserve=max(120,timeoutSeconds+10) seconds; touching the next peak start is refused. Code logic was reviewed, not current provider tariff accuracy or eventual provider billing timestamp.

findings.title: Remote proxy can override non-DeepSeek default to DeepSeek without execution gate
findings.trigger: baseUrl=https://proxy.invalid, default model=gpt-test, actual modelOverride=deepseek-flash during Beijing peak. No real request was made.
findings.mechanism: buildChatModel computes forceOffPeak=false from default model. Four public invocation paths later replace OpenAiChatOptions.model. HTTP layer calls appliesTo(uri,null), so nonofficial proxy cannot be identified from its URI and neither HTTP check executes.
findings.evidence: Fake-transport runtime probe: defaultIdentity=false, effectiveOverrideIdentity=true, peakAllowed=false, unguarded factory reached injected mock execute once. Official endpoint and force=true proxy were rejected with OFF_PEAK_REQUIRED without further mock sends.
findings.effect: Cannot claim all real DeepSeek and remote-proxy sends are guarded. Fixed official-DeepSeek/default-model evaluation path is protected; broader supported override paths are not.
findings.remediation: Revise actual request identity propagation, or conservatively gate every non-local model destination in this isolated evaluation copy. Do not misrepresent a broader local conservative rule as an official pricing requirement for every vendor.
requiredVerification: Remote non-DeepSeek default plus effective DeepSeek override rejected during peak.
Same remote-proxy request created off-peak but queued into peak rejected immediately before fake execute.
Global and BYOK plus escalation and tool routes use protected transport.
Known local fake provider remains operational.
Protected Prompt, retrieval, metric, Gold, comparator, budget and inference options remain byte-identical to historical baseline.

findings.title: Local refusal becomes CALL_FAILED and can appear as unknown usage
findings.mechanism: invoke reserves startModelCall before model.call. Existing catches preserve RequestBudget.Exceeded only; transport Rejected is wrapped as GenerationException.CALL_FAILED. Trace stores null-usage failure and existing self-correction can retry while gate continues to refuse.
findings.effect: A blocked request has no proven provider send or billed usage, even if budget/modelCalls and unknownUsageCalls increment. A long batch crossing peak can accumulate generation failures that reflect local admission, not model quality. Entry check covers pre-batch peak only.
findings.recommendation: Retain as explicit operational limit without changing baseline budget behavior. Gate-interrupted batches are incomplete and unsuitable as comparison accuracy. Do not call refused ledger attempts actual billed model calls.

findings.title: Local admission does not guarantee provider billing completion time
findings.detail: Bounded reserve cannot make process suspension after check, clock changes or provider queue duration impossible. Source URL in code is not current tariff verification. No pricing or current official schedule claim was made.

Covers recognized endpoints, queued send recheck, timezone, weekends, conservative holiday and local fake. Missing non-DeepSeek default/effective DeepSeek override integration case.

verdict.qualification: 7cc2efe retains protected historical inference and evaluation logic and guards fixed official DeepSeek/default-model sends, but fails the all-remote-DeepSeek override requirement. Do not start paid comparison as an unqualified safe baseline.
verdict.followup: Root agent acknowledged B1 and plans separate non-local transport revision. Later source requires supplemental verification; preserve this initial report.
